mentions.name: xqlite
mentions.description: An Elixir library for working with SQLite, with the FFI code written in Rust via the rusqlite crate. It aims to be a super stable SQLite driver for the Elixir ecosystem, avoiding the intermittent crashes of the currently used exqlite library. Remaining work includes shipping a precompiled native library and proper release tagging; the software is otherwise functional.
mentions.problem: The Elixir ecosystem lacks a super stable SQLite driver; the currently used exqlite library reportedly crashes every now and then.
mentions.audience: Elixir developers needing a stable SQLite driver
